pages.note: title page: Syllabus for Hindustani Music (Vocal-Instrumental) (HUQP14)
Note box (exam pattern) then Units 1-6; box title repeats the paper title and is not a row
Units 7-13; Unit 9 has sub-points A-C, C has a-d; Units 10-12 have lettered sub-points

nodes.label: i
nodes.title: The Question Paper will have 75 questions.

nodes.label: ii
nodes.title: All questions will be based on Subject-Specific Knowledge.
Detailed knowledge and the salient features of Ragas & their comparative study
nodes.body: Prescribed Ragas: Bilawal, Alhaiya Bilawal, Bhairav, Kafi, Yaman, Khamaj, Asawari, Bhupali, Deshkar, Brindabani Sarang, Malkauns, Bihag, Bhimpalasi, Bageshri, Des, Jaijaiwanti, Ramkali, Hameer, Kedar, Kamod, Chhayanat, Todi, Multani, Gaud Sarang, Patdeep, Puriya Dhanashri, Shuddha Sarang,Jaunpuri, Shyam Kalyan, Ahir Bhairav, Tilak Kamod, Miyan Ki Malhar, Bahar,Basant, Puriya, Marwa, Sohini, Desi, Pilu, Bhairavi, Shree, Darbari Kanhara, Purvi

nodes.title: Detailed knowledge of the Talas and their comparative study
nodes.body: Prescribed Talas: Dadra, Keharwa, Rupak, Teevra, Jhaptala, Sultala, Ektala, Chautala, Teentala, Tilwada, Dhamar, Jhumra, Ada Chautala, Pancham Savari,

nodes.title: Undestanding of musical terms:
nodes.body: Naad, Dhwani, Shruti, Swara, Saptak, Thaat, Raga, Vadi, Samvadi, Anuvadi, Vivadi, Jati, Varna, Alankar, Sthayi, Antara, Tana, Gamak, Meend, Kan, Krintan, Soot, Zamzama, Ghaseet, Kaku, Avirbav, Tirobhav, Gayak ke gun avagun, Adhwadarshak Swar, Parmel Praveshak Raga, Purvang Vadi Raga,m Uttarang Vadi Raga.

nodes.title: Preliminary idea about Carnatic Music: Swar, Taal, Raga
Acoustics :
nodes.body: Pitch, Intensity, Timbre, Vibration, Forced Vibration, Free Vibration, Just Intonation, Equally Tempered Scale, Harmony, Melody, Polyphony

nodes.title: Musical forms:
nodes.body: Gram, Murcchana, Gandharva, Gaan, Nibhaddha-Anibaddha, Jati Gayan, Prabandha, Dhrupad, Dhamar, Khayal, Tarana, Thumri, Tappa, Bhajan, Chaturang, Maseetkhani Gat, Razakhaani Gat, Alap, Bol-Alap, Jod, Alap, Vilambit Gat, Drut Gat, Jhaala

nodes.title: Laya and Tala:
nodes.body: Laya- Meaning: Vilambit, Madhya, Drut Layakari – Dugun, Tigun Chaugun, Chhagun, Aada, Kuaad Biaad. Tala – Meaning, Avartan, Matra, Tali, Khali, Sam, Vibhag. Dash Pranas Of Tala.

nodes.title: Study of following texts:
nodes.body: Natya Shastra, Brihaddheshi ,Sangeet Makarand, Sangeet Ratnakar, Swarmel Kala Nidhi, Raga Vibodh, Sadragchandrodaya, Raga Tarangini, Sangeet Parijat, Raga Tattwa Vibodh Chaturdandi Prakashika, Geet Govind

nodes.title: Contribution of musician/scholars:
nodes.body: Tansen, Amir Khusru, Jaidev, Sadarang, Adarang, Mansingh Tomar, V.N. Bhatkhande, V.D Paluskar. S.N Ratanjankar, Omkar Nath Thakur, Haddu-Hassu Khan, Bade Gulam Ali Khan, Abdul KarimKhan, Vilayat Hussain Khan, Allaudin Khan, Mushtaq Ali Khan.

nodes.label: A
nodes.title: Classification of Musical Instruments: Tatta, Avnaddha, Ghan, Shushir.

nodes.label: B
nodes.title: Knowledge, construction and tuning of the prominent instruments and playing techniques of Sitar Guitar, Violin, Santoor, Tabla.

nodes.title: Dhrupad- Banis, Dagar, Darbhanga, Betia styles

nodes.label: c
nodes.title: Vocal- Gwailor, Agra, Delhi, Kirana, Jaipur, Patiala, Rampur Sahswan.

Current affairs/ General knowledge on Music
